title: Universal Health Coverage Could Save $1T and 114k Lives a Year, Yale Study
summary: A Yale study quantifies the economic and health benefits of universal health coverage (UHC), estimating it could save $1 trillion and 114,000 lives annually. The analysis models policy impacts, highlighting UHC's potential to reduce mortality and financial strain, though implementation challenges remain. The discussion on Hacker News explores feasibility and trade-offs.
